tvShow.name: Love on Paper
tvShow.overview: When a tycoon prunes her academic dreams, a driven florist signs a temporary pact with her nemesis. As corporate logic wilts under raw chemistry, an unexcavated past threatens to shred their paper-thin “romance”.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After an eco-tycoon unfairly hijacks her hard-earned academic scholarship, an ambitious florist stages a fiery public ambush. But when handcuffs tie them together, a bizarre charade sparks instant chemistry.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Crashing corporate meetings under a fake alias, Leen accidentally seals a mega-deal while testing Aws’s meager patience. But as she vows to walk away, a single discovery exposes the culprit behind her ruined dreams.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Cornered at his ex’s party, Aws invents a velvety lie that breaks the internet. Smarting from her own boyfriend's sudden antics, a deeply hurt Leen acts on pure impulse and gatecrashes a live press conference.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Dictating the stern clauses of a fleeting pact, Leen demands some soft skills from her rigid nemesis. Boundaries are set and secrets are sworn, but spinning a "love at first sight" lie proves easier said than done…

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With a career-defining blueprint on the line, Leen’s brilliant designs manage to mesmerise Aws, and their late-night overtime sparks some ad hoc chemistry. Next on the agenda: a highly volatile, floral-themed merger.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: High-society snobbery and a hostile corporate takeover push a volatile Aws into a public PR disaster. Behind closed doors, an unbudgeted astronomy session completely overrides their corporate pact.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Facing a catastrophic emotional liability at the jeweller’s, a terrified Aws snaps back into his cold tycoon mode. His sudden freeze-out wounds Leen, but a well-timed intrusion shifts the balance again…

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: While Leen’s squad catches Aws and a persistent Julie in some decidedly non-corporate insider trading, a massive counter-bid secures a win that just might break through his emotional defences.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: While a performative apology yields an unexpected truce, an old debt is incinerated. An outsourced swimming lesson triggers a massive jealousy spike and a near-miss romantic merger…

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As Joumana deploys insider corporate espionage, a tight deadline sparks a triumphant office collaboration. Meanwhile, a bitter Julie slips an unapproved Trojan horse into the company roster.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: To fool a suspicious Julie, Leen frantically stages a picture-perfect domestic setup. But while a playful cooking session sparks raw chemistry, an impulsive poolside plunge threatens to sink their secret agreement.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: A business trip to Istanbul quickly turns into a three-ring circus as Aws overplays his romantic hand. While corporate rivalries simmer, an uninvited guest crashes their private suite.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After staging a frantic bedroom-to-boardroom cover-up, Leen deploys her social butterfly charm to salvage a messy business deal. But just as Istanbul sweetens their bond, a defensive Aws starts to backtrack.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: A grueling day of corporate meetings gives way to an unscripted night under the stars. But just as their temporary contract hits its expiration date, an impulsive detour completely derails the closing agenda.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: When Aws calls her bluff with a ridiculous 12-hour solo assignment, a stubborn Leen jumps right in. Next up on the chaotic agenda: a frantic sprint to the jeweller that might just blow the lid off Aws's biggest secret.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: After secretly rallying office troops to her side, Leen takes her rogue faction to the streets to save the project. Meanwhile, the arrival of a handsome rival causes a major smartwatch glitch as Aws's jealousy peaks.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: When a diva pulls out of holding the concert, Leen launches a rescue mission to bring her back. But as Aws and Leen grow closer over a private melody, Julie shows up... ready to burst their romantic bubble.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: While Leen works overtime to mask her rapidly growing feelings, she accidentally goes full ice-queen to protect her heart. Aws, clueless, struggles to decode why he’s being ghosted on his birthday.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Playing Cupid royally backfires when Leen inadvertently books her crush a romantic dinner with someone else. But a strategic tip-off sends a love-struck Aws ditching the high-profile setup for the real deal.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: When classified designs get leaked, Aws (being the hothead that he is) throws a tantrum. Cue the ultimate workplace meltdown: the prime suspect, refusing to be the scapegoat, delivers a dramatic speech and walks out.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: While Zizi plays Sherlock Holmes to find the real culprit, Aws refuses to admit he overreacted. Instead, he doubles down on the drama, turning a simple leftover-box-pickup into a literal bridge-burning war.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Aws hoards secretly salvaged relics, and a jealous rival so fittingly plays the ultimate office snake. Hurt but defiant, the defendant chooses pride over pining, sending off her pseudo-lover to enjoy his new downgrade.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: While an embattled wolf plays the saintly ex to cover her tracks, a makeshift rescue squad connects the sabotage dots. But a hasty, soundless walkout forces Aws to finally decide who he’s running after.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: When his heartbroken muse completely ghosts him, a desperate Aws tracks down her secret haven. But his carefully planned peace talks go spectacularly off-script when the truth (which he came to deny) slips out.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.overview: Reviving their handcuffs incident, Aws stages a mountain escape with Leen to stall for time. As overprotective sidekicks plan a break-in, her panicked reaction turns his romantic retreat into an active crossfire.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.overview: Rain isn’t the only one seeping through the mountain house walls—a smirking Aws is also trying to manoeuvre his way past the pillow fort! But a hysterical video-call interrogation blows his cover…

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.overview: A penniless Salem still insists on living large… leaving Noha to foot his outrageous restaurant tab. But when a rare moment revealing his soft side leads right back to shameless freeloading, Noha draws the line.

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.overview: Backed against a wall? Never! Leen spins a lie about impending nuptials to stall Julie—only for it to blow up in her face! Leen and Aws continue to play their parts while secretly dreading the final countdown…

episodes.name: Episode 30
episodes.overview: A “dress-off” dials up the drama, and a trip to the mountain house turns up the heat! As unfiltered confessions blur the lines of their contract romance, the pseudo-lovers can no longer tell what's real and what's not.

episodes.name: Episode 31
episodes.overview: Chalking his cue with total confidence, Kareem shoots his shot… and sinks his own chances! His grand gesture lands him in the doghouse instead of Yasmeen’s good graces.

episodes.name: Episode 32
episodes.overview: Armed with zero facts and maximum paranoia, Zizi crashes Dana’s workplace, launching a Sofi dragnet! While their quarry ducks right under their noses, Dana wonders if lead detective Zizi is seeing ghosts...

episodes.name: Episode 33
episodes.overview: Driven by sheer panic and late-night impulse, serial dodger Kareem gears up for his charm offensive! With Yasmeen hanging on his every word, his clumsy confession manages the impossible: making things worse.

episodes.name: Episode 34
episodes.overview: Fueled by unresolved trauma, Aws hits the gas in a highway chase! Caught between cold logic and unsaid feelings, he forces an emergency roadside stop for the long-overdue moment of truth.

episodes.name: Episode 35
episodes.overview: Gentle glances and secret rendezvous turn an unspoken goodbye into a magical second chance! As a rekindled romance takes off behind closed doors, dodging eagle-eyed roommates becomes Aws and Leen’s full-time mission.

episodes.name: Episode 36
episodes.overview: Thinking they’ve outsmarted everyone, two sneaky lovebirds get caught red-handed. An intercepted heart-to-heart threatens to undo a dream wedding, as Karma attends the ceremony uninvited.

episodes.name: Episode 37
episodes.overview: A mortifying exit sets off a disastrous chain reaction, just as a hard-headed tycoon turns soft and smitten. With trouble brewing on one too many fronts, a single phone call threatens to bring the house of cards down.

episodes.name: Episode 38
episodes.overview: A slick newcomer plays the humble partner to secure employee buy-in, but his PR stunt only fools some. While hallway politics heats up, off-the-record moves threaten to destabilise the entire firm.

episodes.name: Episode 39
episodes.overview: Determined to give her the world, a hopelessly smitten executive plans a breathtaking grand gesture. Right at the peak of the fairy-tale moment, an off-the-cuff reality check brings the whole setup crashing down.

episodes.name: Episode 40
episodes.overview: Blindsided by a sudden, inexplicable rejection, Leen skips the pity party and stages the ultimate comeback! Re-entering the firm as a force to be reckoned with, she leaves her once-smitten ex utterly speechless.

episodes.name: Episode 41
episodes.overview: Power struggles and petty clashes take over the office as new competition threatens the top dog. Desperate to hold onto his territory, a stubborn executive turns a client pitch into a sneaky rescue mission.

episodes.name: Episode 42
episodes.overview: What a day to get lost in the wilderness! Saved after a bad bump, Leen wakes up sweet as sugar and conveniently oblivious to their feud. Over the moon, Aws plays along, desperate to keep the spell from breaking.

episodes.name: Episode 43
episodes.overview: Back to reality means right back to bickering! But when a discarded note and a slip of the tongue reveal the truth behind Aws's cold act, Leen realises their sudden breakup is not what it seems.

episodes.name: Episode 44
episodes.overview: While Aws secretly plays knight in shining armour to keep a prized flower shop from wilting, Leen turns into his personal shadow! Utterly convinced their love is rock-solid, she’s not leaving until he spills the beans.

episodes.name: Episode 45
episodes.overview: Aws serves up a fake confession to push Leen off his radar! While she processes the ultimate dealbreaker, stealth sabotage targets his blueprints at work, and an uninvited roomie crashes his new bachelor pad.

episodes.name: Episode 46
episodes.overview: Between a bathrobe-clad intruder and a stolen heroic deed, Leen’s fuse burns out! But just as sharp jabs dissolve into a tearful confession, a catastrophe pulls the emergency brake on their showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 47
episodes.overview: Out of the wreckage and straight into a hospital showdown, Leen marks her territory and boots a wannabe rival! With Aws framed for a massive site fiasco, she spearheads an undercover raid to expose the real saboteur!

episodes.name: Episode 48
episodes.overview: Aws and Leen outsmart the office villain right as he thinks he's running the board! But just as tough emotional armour melts into vulnerability, a resentful outsider sharpens her claws for the next round.

episodes.name: Episode 49
episodes.overview: A soul-crushing revelation sends Leen reeling and on a getaway to pick up the broken pieces. Returning on her own terms, she lays down an ironclad rulebook that tests Aws’s unshakeable devotion to its absolute limit!

episodes.name: Episode 50
episodes.overview: An overzealous socialite stages a ploy to reunite the exes, while a matchmaking setup royally backfires! But as love tries to hold on, a calculated leak threatens to turn their private rift into a public frenzy.

episodes.name: Episode 51
episodes.overview: A Prince Charming moment bends the newly established rules, right before a street brawl turns a peaceful night into a bruised sleepover! A bizarre mix-up at the jeweller’s gives an engaged pair a lesson in love.

episodes.name: Episode 52
episodes.overview: A side of devastating truth with morning coffee leaves Aws and Leen’s guilt-ridden romance on thin ice! While Aws promises to move mountains for a second chance, an uninvited seductress gets locked out in the cold.

episodes.name: Episode 53
episodes.overview: Desperate times call for a log to the skull: the ultimate rampage-stopping tool! When a blunt-force knock-out melts into a sweet, hostage-inspired truce, a sneaky family charade sets the stage for a total love reboot.
